**Use one day before as the trial default.** Across all eight matinees, 81.6% of reservations resulted in attendance with a one-day reminder, compared with 74.6% with a three-day reminder. Giving each show equal weight also favored one day, by 7.2 percentage points. Excluding the two school holidays widened the weighted gap to 9.3 points.

Staff availability determined reminder timing, so the comparison cannot establish how much of the gap the reminder caused.
